stem: If you don't know the word, please ____ in the dictionary.

stem: My grandmother is sick, so my mother has to ____ her every day.

stem: My brother never ____ early on weekends; he sleeps until noon.
explain_zh: 後面說睡到中午，可見是「起床」很晚，用 get up。get down 是下來、get away 是逃離、get over 是克服，語意都不對。

stem: It is cold outside. ____ your coat before you go out.

stem: She ____ her new dress and looked in the mirror happily.
explain_zh: put on 是「穿上」，穿上新洋裝後照鏡子最合理。put in 是投入、put up 是張貼、put off 是延期，都不能和 dress 搭配。

stem: Remember to ____ the TV before you go to bed tonight.
explain_zh: 睡覺前要「關掉」電視，用 turn off。turn on 是打開，turn up 是調大聲或出現，turn into 是變成，都和睡前的動作不符。

stem: Don't forget to ____ the water when you brush your teeth.

stem: The math problem was very hard, but Jack did not ____.
explain_zh: but 表示題目雖難他仍不「放棄」，用 give up。give out 是發放或用盡，give back 是歸還，give away 是送出，語意都不對。

stem: My father decided to ____ smoking for his own health.
explain_zh: give up + 動名詞 表示「戒掉、放棄做某事」，give up smoking 就是戒菸。give out 是發放，give off 是散發氣味，give away 是贈送。

stem: The police are trying to ____ who broke the school window.
explain_zh: find out 是「查明、查出」事情的真相。find in 不是片語，look out 是「小心」，take out 是拿出，都不能表示查明真相。

stem: I called the bookstore to ____ what time it closes today.
explain_zh: 打電話詢問資訊是 find out（查明、問清楚）。find off 不是英文片語，get out 是出去，run out 是用完，都不符合語意。

stem: The printer ____ paper, so we cannot print the report now.

stem: Hurry up! We are ____ time before the movie starts.
explain_zh: run out of time 是「時間快用完了」，和 Hurry up 呼應。run after 是追趕，run into 是撞上或巧遇，run over 是輾過，都不合語意。

stem: My sister is very ____ drawing cartoon characters on paper.

stem: Tom is not ____ swimming, but he practices every week.

stem: Many students are ____ joining the school basketball club.
explain_zh: be interested in 是「對……有興趣」，in 後面可接名詞或動名詞 joining。interested on／at／for 都不是正確搭配。

stem: I became ____ history after watching that wonderful movie.
explain_zh: become 後面要接形容詞，且人感到有興趣用 interested。interest 是名詞或動詞，interesting 是「令人感興趣的」用來形容事物，interested of 搭配錯誤。

stem: Whether we go hiking tomorrow ____ the weather in the morning.
explain_zh: depend on 是「取決於、依靠」，主詞是 Whether 子句視為單數，所以用 depends on。depend of／in／to 都不是正確搭配。

stem: Young children usually ____ their parents for food and money.
explain_zh: depend on somebody for something 表示「在某方面依靠某人」。depend 的固定介系詞只有 on（或 upon），其他三個都不對。

stem: Let's take the MRT ____ a taxi. It is much faster.
explain_zh: instead of + 名詞 表示「而不是……」。instead 是副詞，後面不能直接接名詞；because of 是因為；in spite of 是儘管，語意都不對。

stem: He drank water ____ cola because he wants to be healthier.
explain_zh: instead of 是固定片語，of 不能換成其他介系詞。instead for、instead to、instead from 都不是英文用法。

stem: I will call you ____ I get home from school tonight.

stem: ____ the bell rang, the students ran out of the classroom.
explain_zh: As soon as 引導時間副詞子句，表示鐘聲一響就……。As soon、So soon、Soon as 都不是正確的連接詞形式。

stem: She is ____ a good singer but also a great dancer.
explain_zh: not only A but also B 是「不但……而且……」的固定句型，前後要成對出現。no only、not any、neither only 都不是正確用法。

stem: He can not only speak English ____ write it very well.
explain_zh: 前面有 not only，後面一定要接 but also 才能形成對稱句型。and also、but too、also but 都不能和 not only 搭配。

stem: My grandfather is used to ____ up early every single morning.

stem: After a month in Tainan, I ____ the hot weather there.
explain_zh: be used to + 名詞 表示「習慣了……」。am use to 少了過去分詞形式，used to 是「以前曾經」且後面要接原形動詞，be used for 是「被用來」。

stem: We ____ the bus for twenty minutes in the heavy rain.
explain_zh: wait for somebody／something 是「等待」，介系詞固定用 for。wait to 後面要接原形動詞，wait at 是在某處等，wait on 是服侍。

stem: The plane to Japan will ____ in about ten minutes.
explain_zh: take off 用在飛機上是「起飛」。take out 是拿出，take up 是占用或開始學習，take away 是帶走，都不能形容飛機離地。

stem: What time do you usually ____ school in the morning?

stem: My little cousin is ____ the dark, so he sleeps with a light.
explain_zh: be afraid of + 名詞 表示「害怕……」。afraid for 是替某人擔心，afraid at 和 afraid with 都不是英文用法。

stem: Tainan is ____ its delicious snacks and beautiful old temples.
explain_zh: be famous for + 特色 表示「以……聞名」。famous of、famous with、famous to 都不是正確搭配；be famous as 則是「以……身分出名」。

stem: More than fifty students ____ the singing contest last year.
explain_zh: take part in 是「參加（活動）」的固定片語，介系詞只能用 in。take part of、at、on 都不是正確搭配。

stem: Could you ____ my English homework tonight? I don't understand it.
explain_zh: help somebody with something 表示「幫某人做某事」，介系詞用 with。help me on／at／of 都不是正確搭配。

stem: Please ____ what the teacher says during the class.
explain_zh: pay attention to 是「注意、專心於」，介系詞固定用 to。pay attention on／at 搭配錯誤，attention 也不和 take 連用。

stem: She ____ all of her new classmates very well this semester.
explain_zh: get along with somebody 是「和某人相處融洽」。gets along to／on 介系詞錯誤，gets long with 則是把 along 誤寫成 long。

stem: We are all ____ the summer vacation next month.
explain_zh: look forward to 是「期待」，to 是介系詞，後面要接名詞。少了 to 或換成 for 都不對，looking front to 更不是英文片語。

stem: It is easy to ____ new people in the school guitar club.
explain_zh: make friends with somebody 是「和某人交朋友」，friends 一定要用複數，介系詞用 with。make friends to、make friend with、do friends with 都不正確。

stem: The bookstore is ____ the train station, just across the road.
explain_zh: in front of + 地點 表示「在……前面」，後面有受詞時三個字缺一不可。in the front 是「在（內部的）前段」，in front 和 front of 都不能直接接名詞。

stem: The high speed rail is always ____; it never leaves late.

stem: Doctors say students should sleep ____ eight hours every night.
explain_zh: at least 是「至少」，符合醫師建議的最低睡眠時數。at last 是「最後終於」，at first 是「起初」，in the least 多用於否定句表示「一點也不」。

stem: My little brother can ride a bike ____ now; nobody helps him.
explain_zh: by oneself 是「獨自、靠自己」，主詞是 my little brother 所以用 by himself。正確說法是 on his own 或 by himself，by his own、by him、of himself 都不對。

stem: Let me ____ your new phone. It looks really cool.
explain_zh: take a look at something 是「看一下某樣東西」，後面有受詞時一定要加 at。take a look 後面不能直接接名詞，take look at 少了冠詞，look 也不和 make 連用。

stem: My grandmother ____ a small village in Yilan sixty years ago.
explain_zh: be born in + 較大的地方 表示「出生於」，born 本身就是過去分詞。at 用於很小的定點不適合村莊，born in 少了 be 動詞，borned 更是錯誤拼法。

stem: Don't ____ the test. You have studied very hard this month.
explain_zh: worry about something 是「擔心某事」，介系詞固定用 about。worry of、worry for、worry on 都不是正確搭配。
